mainImage.alt: Construction equipment and scaffolding surround the partially demolished East Wing of the White House with exposed structural beams and debris
mainImage.caption: Demolition continues on the East Wing of the White House in Washington, D.C., on October 21, 2025, to make way for President Trump's proposed $400 million ballroom project.

body.alt: Donald Trump standing at a podium in the decorated East Room of the White House, holding a model of an arch, addressing an audience of corporate donors seated at formal dinner tables
body.caption: President Donald Trump speaks during a dinner with corporate donors to his White House ballroom project in the East Room of the White House, October 15, 2025.

body.alt: Aerial view showing multiple construction cranes and exposed structural framework at the site where the White House East Wing once stood, with the rest of the White House complex visible nearby
body.caption: Construction cranes and heavy machinery work on the demolished East Wing of the White House in Washington, D.C., as part of Trump's ballroom construction project, March 2026.
